disclaimer: Service identity catalogue for architecture recommendations only. This is not a pricing file: it contains no prices, quotas or SLAs. Names, URLs, limits and region availability must be re-verified against the provider documentation before any real implementation.
source_note: Entries were compiled by the NYX maintainers from public provider product pages (2026.10 snapshot). Limitations are summary notes, not exhaustive.

aws.alb.name: Application Load Balancer
limitations: Hourly plus LCU charges; not scale-to-zero.

aws.api_gateway.name: Amazon API Gateway
limitations: Per-request pricing; WebSocket and REST APIs have different limits.
Request payload and integration timeout limits apply.

aws.backup.name: AWS Backup
limitations: Policy coverage depends on supported resource types.

aws.batch.name: AWS Batch
limitations: Runs on managed EC2 or Fargate capacity; job queues need configuration.

aws.beanstalk.name: AWS Elastic Beanstalk
limitations: Provisions EC2 instances underneath; instances are billed while running.

aws.cloudfront.name: Amazon CloudFront
limitations: Requires an origin such as S3 or a load balancer.

aws.cloudwatch.name: Amazon CloudWatch
limitations: Custom metrics and log ingestion are billed separately.

aws.codeartifact.name: AWS CodeArtifact
limitations: Stores packages and artefacts; it is not a CI runner.

aws.cognito.name: Amazon Cognito
limitations: Customer-identity focus; workforce federation has separate configuration.

aws.dynamodb.name: Amazon DynamoDB
limitations: Access patterns must be designed up front; limited ad-hoc querying.

aws.ebs.name: Amazon Elastic Block Store
limitations: Attached to a single instance in a single Availability Zone per volume.

aws.ec2.name: Amazon EC2
limitations: Operating system patching and capacity management remain customer responsibilities.

aws.ecs_fargate.name: Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate
limitations: Task-level vCPU and memory sizing; minimum billed duration per task.

aws.elasticache.name: Amazon ElastiCache
limitations: Node or cluster sizing is required; Serverless tier has a minimum footprint.

aws.eventbridge_scheduler.name: Amazon EventBridge Scheduler
limitations: Schedule invocation targets are limited to supported AWS services and HTTP endpoints.

aws.kinesis.name: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams
limitations: Shard or on-demand capacity modes change the cost shape.

aws.lambda.name: AWS Lambda
limitations: Maximum execution time of 15 minutes per invocation.
Cold starts can affect latency-sensitive paths.

aws.lambda_powertools_logging.name: AWS Lambda Powertools (structured logging)
limitations: A library rather than a managed service; logs still land in CloudWatch Logs.

aws.opensearch.name: Amazon OpenSearch Service
limitations: Domain sizing and shard management remain operator tasks.

aws.rds.name: Amazon RDS
limitations: Instance sizing is required; RDS Proxy is often needed for connection-heavy workloads.

aws.redshift.name: Amazon Redshift
limitations: Cluster or serverless capacity planning is needed for predictable performance.

aws.route53.name: Amazon Route 53
limitations: Health checks and routing policies are billed per resource.

aws.s3.name: Amazon S3
limitations: Object-based; not a POSIX filesystem.

aws.secrets_manager.name: AWS Secrets Manager
limitations: Per-secret and per-API-call charges; rotation needs a rotation function.

aws.ses.name: Amazon Simple Email Service
limitations: New accounts start in a sandbox with sending limits.

aws.sns.name: Amazon Simple Notification Service
limitations: Fan-out delivery; no durable consumer-side buffering by itself.

aws.sqs.name: Amazon Simple Queue Service
limitations: Standard queues are at-least-once with no strict ordering; FIFO queues have throughput limits.

aws.timestream.name: Amazon Timestream
limitations: Purpose-built time-series model; query language differs from SQL databases.

azure.ai_search.name: Azure AI Search
limitations: Search units are provisioned and billed while the service exists.

azure.api_management.name: Azure API Management
limitations: Dedicated tiers run always-on units; the consumption tier is the only scale-to-zero option.

azure.app_service.name: Azure App Service
limitations: App Service plans are billed while allocated, even when idle.

azure.application_gateway.name: Azure Application Gateway
limitations: Layer 7 only; capacity units are billed continuously.

azure.azure_dns.name: Azure DNS
limitations: Zones and query volume are billed.

azure.backup.name: Azure Backup
limitations: Vault-based policies; retention and restore costs vary by workload.

azure.batch.name: Azure Batch
limitations: Pools of VMs must be sized and managed by the job scheduler.

azure.blob_storage.name: Azure Blob Storage
limitations: Object-based; hierarchical namespace is an optional feature.

azure.cache_redis.name: Azure Cache for Redis
limitations: Tier and size are fixed per cache instance.

azure.container_apps.name: Azure Container Apps
limitations: Consumption plan can scale to zero; dedicated plans are always allocated.

azure.cosmos_db.name: Azure Cosmos DB
limitations: Throughput (RU/s) provisioning or serverless mode must be chosen per account.

azure.data_explorer.name: Azure Data Explorer
limitations: Cluster sizing is required; optimised for log and telemetry analytics.

azure.devops_pipelines.name: Azure Pipelines
limitations: Hosted agent minutes are metered; self-hosted agents are customer-managed.

azure.entra_id.name: Microsoft Entra ID
limitations: Workforce-first product; customer identity uses Entra External ID.

azure.event_hubs.name: Azure Event Hubs
limitations: Throughput units or capacity modes are billed while provisioned.

azure.fabric_synapse.name: Microsoft Fabric / Azure Synapse Analytics
limitations: Capacity-based model; product choice depends on the analytics platform strategy.

azure.front_door.name: Azure Front Door
limitations: Tiers differ in WAF and private-link support.

azure.functions.name: Azure Functions
limitations: Consumption plan default timeout is 5 minutes; Premium plan removes cold-start limits.

azure.key_vault.name: Azure Key Vault
limitations: Operation-based charges; managed HSM is a separate tier.

azure.logic_apps.name: Azure Logic Apps
limitations: Workflow designer model; recurrence triggers are the scheduling option.

azure.managed_disks.name: Azure Managed Disks
limitations: Disks attach to Azure virtual machines only.

azure.monitor.name: Azure Monitor
limitations: Log Analytics ingestion is the main cost driver.

azure.notification_hubs.name: Azure Notification Hubs
limitations: Push-focused; email delivery needs Azure Communication Services.

azure.service_bus.name: Azure Service Bus
limitations: Premium tier needed for dedicated capacity and some enterprise features.

azure.sql_database.name: Azure SQL Database
limitations: DTU or vCore purchasing model; serverless tier can auto-pause.

azure.virtual_machines.name: Azure Virtual Machines
limitations: Operating system patching and scaling remain customer responsibilities.

gcp.api_gateway.name: API Gateway (Google Cloud)
limitations: Lighter policy surface than Apigee; governance-heavy programs may need Apigee.

gcp.backup_dr.name: Backup and DR Service
limitations: Coverage depends on the protected workload type.

gcp.bigquery.name: BigQuery
limitations: On-demand pricing per bytes scanned; partitioning controls cost.

gcp.cloud_build.name: Cloud Build
limitations: Build minutes are billed; private pools change the network model.

gcp.cloud_cdn.name: Cloud CDN
limitations: Requires an external HTTP(S) load balancer as the origin path.

gcp.cloud_dns.name: Cloud DNS
limitations: Zones and query volume are billed.

gcp.cloud_load_balancing.name: Cloud Load Balancing
limitations: Global forwarding rules differ from per-region load balancer instances.

gcp.cloud_logging.name: Cloud Logging
limitations: Ingestion above the free allowance is billed; retention tiers differ.

gcp.cloud_monitoring.name: Cloud Monitoring
limitations: Metric volume and alerting policies drive cost.

gcp.cloud_run.name: Cloud Run
limitations: Request timeout limits apply; container image must follow the Cloud Run contract.

gcp.cloud_run_functions.name: Cloud Run functions
limitations: Built on Cloud Run; supports event-triggered and HTTP entry points.

gcp.cloud_run_jobs.name: Cloud Run jobs
limitations: Run-to-completion tasks; not a long-lived service.

gcp.cloud_scheduler.name: Cloud Scheduler
limitations: Cron-style triggers; per-job pricing applies.

gcp.cloud_sql.name: Cloud SQL
limitations: Instance sizing and maintenance windows must be configured.

gcp.cloud_storage.name: Cloud Storage
limitations: Object-based; storage classes change retrieval cost.

gcp.cloud_tasks.name: Cloud Tasks
limitations: Task-oriented queue with dispatch rate limits; not a high-throughput event bus.

gcp.compute_engine.name: Compute Engine
limitations: Virtual machines require patching and capacity planning.

gcp.firebase_messaging.name: Firebase Cloud Messaging
limitations: Push delivery only; email requires a separate service.

gcp.firestore.name: Firestore
limitations: Query model is index-driven with no joins.

gcp.identity_platform.name: Identity Platform
limitations: Customer identity; workforce identity uses Cloud Identity instead.

gcp.managed_prometheus.name: Google Cloud Managed Service for Prometheus
limitations: Prometheus-compatible metrics; long-term analytics usually need another store.

gcp.memorystore.name: Memorystore for Redis
limitations: Instance-based capacity; no scale-to-zero.

gcp.persistent_disk.name: Persistent Disk
limitations: Zonal or regional disks attached to Compute Engine instances.

gcp.pubsub.name: Pub/Sub
limitations: Topic and subscription model; ordering keys needed for ordered delivery.

gcp.secret_manager.name: Secret Manager
limitations: Per-version and per-access-operation charges.

gcp.vertex_ai.name: Vertex AI
limitations: Endpoints run on provisioned capacity unless batch prediction is used.

gcp.vertex_ai_search.name: Vertex AI Search
limitations: Managed search with less index-level control than self-managed engines.
